A thoughtful first visit

Start with
a conversation.

Your goals, hair history and everyday routine are a useful place to begin. A photo of the look you love can help, too.

01 / CHOOSE YOUR START

Make the next step easy.

Know your service? Open the menu and choose your visit. Planning a big change or unsure what to book? Send a message first.

02 / BRING YOUR VISION

Bring a photo of the look you want.

Bring a current hair photo, an inspiration photo and anything you want your stylist to know about previous color or treatments.

03 / PLAN THE CARE

Think beyond today.

Ask about styling at home, products, upkeep and the timing of your next appointment. Good care carries on between visits.

A few helpful answers

Before you
settle into the chair.

Ask about your hair history, the service you need or your upcoming visit.

Ask about this template ↗
What should I book for my first visit?

If you know the service you want, choose it from the booking menu. For a color change, extensions or uncertainty about appointment length, ask your stylist before choosing. The menu includes color correction and extensions consultations.

Do you offer consultations?

The menu lists a complimentary 10 minute color correction consultation and a complimentary 15 minute extensions consultation. A bridal hair consultation is $80 for 90 minutes. Select the matching service in the booking menu.

Where do I see prices and available times?

Service prices and listed lengths are shown here. The booking menu has the current availability and complete service combinations. Confirm the price, service details and any policy before completing your booking.

Can I ask about curls, texture or previous color?

Absolutely. Describe your hair and what you want to change. Share your recent color or treatment history so your stylist can help you choose the right appointment.

How do I reschedule or check cancellation terms?

Use the information in your booking confirmation, or contact your stylist directly. Confirm cancellation, deposit and rescheduling terms in the booking menu before reserving your time.

Can I give someone a gift?

Connect your salon’s gift card checkout to this template so guests can buy a gift using your existing system.
